entities.name: Vadrik, Astral Archmage
entities.description: A human astronomancer and powerful wizard from Innistrad with over 40 years of experience, husband of Hailin.

entities.name: Jenrik
entities.description: Vadrik's old friend whose favor calls him into the field.

entities.name: Hailin
entities.description: Man from Lambholt married to Vadrik.

entities.name: Lambholt
entities.description: Village where Vadrik was called by the elders.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: Hired by Dein Salvasi; worked with Vadrik.

entities.name: Arinos
entities.description: Farmer who disappeared; he summoned Old Stickfingers to kill Salvasi.

entities.name: Dein Salvasi
entities.description: Pious richest man in Lambholt and suspect in Arinos' disappearance.

entities.name: Malynn
entities.description: Lambholt elder who suspected Old Stickfingers.

entities.name: Old Stickfingers
entities.description: A creature summoned by Arinos to kill Salvasi.

events.summary: Vadrik goes to Lambholt after being called by village elders and meets Rem Karolus; both are employed to find the missing farmer Arinos.
events.quote: Vadrik went to Lambholt , after being called upon by the village elders.

events.summary: Vadrik, Rem and Malynn find Old Stickfingers and fight and wound it.
events.quote: engaged it in battle, wounding it

events.summary: Ariosa reveals Salvasi threatened to take Arinos' lands; the group finds Salvasi's house deserted and learns Arinos summoned Old Stickfingers to kill Salvasi.
events.quote: it was in fact Arinos who had summoned Old Stickfingers to kill Salvasi

events.summary: Vadrik and Rem contain Old Stickfingers with a ritual and part on good terms; Vadrik returns home to his husband.
events.quote: After employing a ritual to contain Old Stickfingers

relations.quote: Vadrik is married to a man from Lambholt named Hailin .
He is friends with Arlinn Kord .
a favor for his old friend Jenrik
Arinos who had summoned Old Stickfingers
